tools.name: luw_interior_design
tools.description: Luw.ai Interior AI: redesign an interior photo — home, office, shop, hotel — in any style while keeping the room's architecture. Restyles furniture, materials, colors and lighting. Set empty_room=true to furnish an empty room or turn it into another room type (virtual staging). Costs 1 credit per variation.

image.description: Photo of the room (https:// URL, local file path, or data: URI).

prompt.description: What you want, in plain language.

styles.description: Design style names, e.g. ["Scandinavian"]; for Japandi use ["Japanese Design", "Scandinavian"]. Case-sensitive; see luw_list_options.

room_type.description: Room type, e.g. "Living Room", "Kitchen", "Bedroom", "Home Office" (see luw_list_options kind="interior_types").

empty_room.description: Furnish from scratch / convert the room to room_type (Fill Empty Room mode).

style_reference.description: Style-transfer source: an image whose look to copy (https:// URL, local file path, or data: URI), or "persona" to use slot 1 of persona_id.

reference_images.description: Up to 6 reference images (furniture, materials, products, mood boards) to draw from.

items.description: Reference image (https:// URL, local file path, or data: URI).

precision.description: How strictly to keep the input's structure: 90 = precise, 75 = balanced, 40 = creative.

enhance_prompt.description: Let Luw.ai's prompt enhancer expand a short prompt.

variations.description: Number of alternative designs (1-4, default 1); each is billed as a generation.

persona_id.description: Persona whose saved images and style knowledge to use.

Pass products, materials or a mood board as reference_images to place or apply them. For edits restricted to an exact area, use luw_magic_wand. Costs 1 credit per variation.

tools.name: luw_magic_wand
tools.description: Luw.ai Magic Wand AI: change only a masked area of an image. Give a prompt to add/replace what's there, remove=true to erase it, or material_image to re-surface it (e.g. new flooring or wall tiles). The mask is a black-and-white image the same size as the input; white marks the area to change. Get masks from luw_segment. Costs 1 credit.

image.description: Image to edit (https:// URL, local file path, or data: URI).

mask_image.description: Black/white mask, white = area to change (https:// URL, local file path, or data: URI).

prompt.description: What to put in the masked area.

remove.description: Remove whatever is in the masked area.

material_image.description: Material/texture to apply to the masked area (https:// URL, local file path, or data: URI); luw_list_options kind="materials" has a ready-made catalog.

keep_structure.description: Preserve the masked area's geometry/lines while changing its look (structure-guided fill).

enhance_prompt.description: Let Luw.ai's prompt enhancer expand a short prompt.

tools.name: luw_segment
tools.description: Luw.ai Segment AI: detect objects in a photo and return black-and-white masks as image URLs — every object (wall, floor, sofa, …) or only what you describe in prompt. Feed a mask URL into luw_magic_wand or luw_landscape_design to edit exactly that area. Costs 1 credit.

prompt.description: What to segment, e.g. "walls", "the sofa", "lawn". Omit to segment everything.

labels.description: Keep only masks whose label contains one of these words (e.g. ["floor", "wall"]).

image.description: Optional reference image (https:// URL, local file path, or data: URI).

tools.name: luw_generate_video
tools.description: Luw.ai Video AI (Motion): animate a design image into a short cinematic video — fly-throughs, dolly moves, drone shots, reveals. Camera motions: A Forward Dolly, Flythrough Cinematic, Return to Empty Room, Lighting and Color Details, Drone flying to center, Dramatic Zoom Out, Reverse Zoom In, Slow Pull Back, Reveal Zoom, Ground to Sky Tilt, Side Tracking Zoom, Aerial Descent. Takes a few minutes — expect a processing_url to collect with luw_get_result. Costs 10 credits (aria) or 20 (symphony).

image.description: Start frame (a render or photo) (https:// URL, local file path, or data: URI).

prompt.description: What should happen in the video.

camera_motion.description: One of the camera motions listed above, e.g. "Flythrough Cinematic".

tools.name: luw_image_to_3d
tools.description: Luw.ai 3DGen AI: generate a textured 3D model (GLB) from a photo of an object — furniture, decor, products. Add up to 3 photos from other angles for better accuracy. For text-to-3D, first make an image with luw_generate_image. Costs 3 credits (aria) or 8 (symphony).

image.description: Photo of the object (https:// URL, local file path, or data: URI).

items.description: Another angle of the same object (https:// URL, local file path, or data: URI).

tools.name: luw_get_result
tools.description: Collect the result of a Luw.ai generation that was still processing (tools return a processing_url when a job outlasts their wait). Waits for the job to finish (up to the server's wait limit) — call again if it's still running. Free; never re-run a generation instead.

processing_url.description: The processing_url returned by a generation tool.

source_image.description: The source returned with that processing_url (the job's input image), so the result is shown before and after.

wait.description: Wait for completion (default true). false = check once and return immediately.

tools.name: luw_upload_file
tools.description: Upload an image, video or 3D file to Luw.ai storage and get a URL usable by every Luw.ai tool. Rarely needed: all tools already accept local paths and data: URIs and upload them automatically. Useful to get a shareable URL, to re-host an image from a site Luw.ai can't reach, or to store a file permanently.

source.description: Local file path, file:// URL, data: URI, or an https:// URL to copy into Luw.ai storage.

persistent.description: Keep the file in your Luw.ai storage permanently. Default: temporary, auto-deleted after 12 hours.

persona_id.description: Persona to store a persistent file under (default: your first persona).

tools.name: luw_list_options
tools.description: Look up valid values for other Luw.ai tools: design_styles (styles param), interior_types (room_type), exterior_types (building_type), video_styles (camera_motion), materials (Magic Wand material_image catalog), professions (persona profession). Free.

details.description: Include descriptions and preview image URLs (longer output).

tools.name: luw_run_model
tools.description: Call POST /generate with raw API parameters, for models or options the dedicated tools don't cover (e.g. persona-slot inputs, webhooks). Models: interior, exterior, sketch, render, magicprompt, magicwand, moodboard, landscape, enhance, expand, vector, removefurniture, segment, segmentprompt, fluw, fluwvector, pattern, changebg, removebg, video, 3dgen. Parameter reference: https://luw-ai.gitbook.io/api. Image fields (image, mask_image, material_image, style_transfer, extra_image_1…6) also accept local paths and data: URIs. Spends credits like the model's own tool.

model.description: Model id, e.g. interior or magicprompt.

tools.name: luw_archigpt
tools.description: Ask Luw.ai's ArchiGPT, an AI architect: design advice, feng shui, space planning, material and color suggestions, technical questions, and estimating square meters from a photo or plan. Attach an image to discuss it. Each call is a standalone question, so put the details it depends on into the message. Costs 1 credit per ~3000 words.

message.description: Your question or message, with the details it depends on.

image.description: Image to discuss (https:// URL, local file path, or data: URI).

language.description: Reply language, e.g. "en" or "tr". Auto-detected when omitted.

tools.name: luw_personas
tools.description:
Personas hold a reusable design identity: style knowledge plus saved images (trainings). Slots 1-6 train the persona's visual style (slot 1 is the style-transfer reference used by style_reference="persona"), slot 7 is the default input image, 8+ are free-form data; add_training without a slot "likes" a design. Pass persona_id to generation tools to use one.
Actions: list, get, create, update, delete, list_trainings, add_training, update_training, delete_training, clear_slot.

knows.description: Comma-separated style knowledge, e.g. "Modern,Minimalism" or room/building types.

profession.description: Tool the persona belongs to, e.g. Interior, Exterior, MagicPrompt, MagicWand, Enhance, Video, Render, 3DGen, Fluw, Sketch, Landscape, MoodBoard, ArchiGPT. For list: only that tool's personas (fast).

image.description: Training image (https:// URL, local file path, or data: URI); stored permanently.

extras.description: Extra metadata, e.g. the prompt behind a liked design.

tools.name: luw_projects
tools.description:
Organize work in Luw.ai projects (called boards in the API), with nested folders and media. Use add_media to save generated results into a project.
Actions: list, get, create, rename, delete, list_folders, create_folder, update_folder, delete_folder, add_media, delete_media, move_media.

folder_id.description: Folder to act on, or target folder for add_media/move_media (omit = project root).

url.description: add_media: the media (https:// URL, local file path, or data: URI).

control_image.description: add_media: optional source/reference image, e.g. the original photo of a redesign.

extras.description: add_media: metadata as a JSON string, e.g. {"prompt": "…"}.

instructions:
Luw.ai: AI tools for interior, exterior and landscape design, architectural rendering, image editing, video and 3D.
Image inputs accept https:// URLs, local file paths or data: URIs; local files are uploaded to Luw.ai automatically.
Generations wait up to 50s. A tool that returns a processing_url is still running; luw_get_result collects it and can be called again while it runs. Running the generation again would use credits twice.
Each generation uses credits from the user's Luw.ai account; variations multiply the cost.
luw_list_options lists valid style, room type, camera motion and material names.
To change one exact area, luw_segment returns a mask for luw_magic_wand or luw_landscape_design.
Without an API key, calls fail with setup steps; keys are created at https://app.luw.ai/dashboard/api.
